parsed.refutation_attempt: Attempted to determine whether the use of std::ofstream::open could trigger shell command execution. Verified that std::ofstream::open directly calls the underlying OS open(2) system call (or equivalent) and does not invoke a shell or interpret metacharacters in the file name. Therefore, even though m_name may contain characters such as spaces, quotes, or shell metacharacters, they are treated as literal characters in the file path rather than as shell syntax, and no OS command injection can occur.
